title: Transmitter
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Transmitters and Receivers/Transmitter.md
text: 放大并发射信号，输入 1 路、输出 3 路；按 {Gain method} 指定增益方法；{Peak power (W)} 指定峰值功率、{Gain (dB)} 指定线性发射机增益、{Output IP3 (dBm)} 输出 IP3、{Lookup table} 查找表、{Loss factor (dB)} 指定发射损耗因子、{Enable transmitter status output}、{Preserve coherence among pulses}、{Enable pulse phase noise output}、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted、{Add noise to input signal} 指定向输入信号添加噪声、{Input noise temperature (K)} 指定输入噪声温度、{Noise method} 指定噪声方法 None、{Noise figure (dB)} 指定噪声系数、{Noise factor} 指定噪声因子、{Reference temperature (K)} 指定参考温度、{Sample rate (Hz)} 指定采样率 1e6、{Inherit sample rate} 指定从上游模块继承采样率、{Phased offset (degrees)} 指定相位偏移、{Source of seed for random number generator} 指定随机数生成器的种子来源、{Seed for random number generator} 指定随机数生成器的种子，按实例取值。

params.name: Peak power (W)
params.values: 峰值功率 5000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Gain method
params.values: 增益方法 Linear (default) | Cubic polynomial | Lookup table

params.name: Gain (dB)
params.values: 线性发射机增益 20 (default) | real scalar | length- N vector of real values

params.name: Output IP3 (dBm)
params.values: 输出 IP3 Inf (default) | scalar | length- N vector of real values

params.name: Lookup table
params.values: 查找表 [-25, 5, -1; -10, 20, -2; 0, 27, 5; 5, 28, 12] (default) | M -by- N real-valued matrix | M -by- N real-valued matrix

params.name: Loss factor (dB)
params.values: 发射损耗因子 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar | length- N vector of nonnegative values

params.name: Enable transmitter status output
params.values: Enable transmitter status output off (default) | on

params.name: Preserve coherence among pulses
params.values: Preserve coherence among pulses on (default) | off

params.name: Enable pulse phase noise output
params.values: Enable pulse phase noise output off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation

params.name: Add noise to input signal
params.values: 向输入信号添加噪声 off (default) | on

params.name: Input noise temperature (K)
params.values: 输入噪声温度 290 (default) | positive scalar | length- N vector of positive values

params.name: Noise method
params.values: 噪声方法 None | Noise figure | Noise factor | Noise temperature

params.name: Noise figure (dB)
params.values: 噪声系数 3 (default) | real scalar | length- N vector or real values

params.name: Noise factor
params.values: 噪声因子 2 (default) | positive scalar | length- N vector of positive values

params.name: Reference temperature (K)
params.values: 参考温度 290 (default) | positive scalar | length- N vector of positive values

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 采样率 1e6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Inherit sample rate
params.values: 从上游模块继承采样率 on (default) | off

params.name: Phased offset (degrees)
params.values: 相位偏移 0 (default) | scalar | length- N vector of real values

params.values: 随机数生成器的种子来源 Auto (default) | Property
